elaboration_type.description: converges=confirms existing properties. diverges_dimension=expands gradient. diverges_property=adds property. diverges_condition=reveals condition. diverges_strong=suggests subdividing.

description.description: Narrative description of how the incident relates to the category. What it reveals, confirms, or expands.

expanded_definition.description: New proposed definition IF the elaboration expands it. Empty string if unchanged.

new_or_expanded_properties.description: New or expanded properties. Empty array if elaboration_type=converges.

is_new.description: true if it is a new property, false if an existing gradient was expanded.

previous_gradient.description: Previous gradient. Only if an existing one was expanded.

suggested_action.description: Recommended action for the researcher. none if converges.

rename_suggested.description: true if the definition changed enough to suggest a rename.

rename_candidates.description: Suggested names following the configured coding style. Empty array if not.

elaboration_note.description: Free note from the elaborator: what does this incident reveal about the category? What questions remain open?
